ideas.pitch: An offline-first agricultural monitoring system that runs anomaly detection models directly on a Snapdragon NPU connected to a local camera and sensor node to optimize water usage and spot crop disease without cloud latency.
ideas.title: Edge-AI Smart Farm Irrigation and Pest Drone
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with Agriculture and Smart Farming while leveraging the hard-engineering pattern of offline on-device AI from the Qualcomm hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision monitoring pipeline that flags workers lacking hard hats or high-visibility vests in hazardous industrial zones, running locally on edge hardware with instant audio alerts.
ideas.title: Industrial Safety Violation and PPE Edge Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven winning formula of industrial safety and computer vision integration seen in recent hackathon champions.

ideas.pitch: A 5-layer multi-agent diagnostic platform powered by Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph that autonomously monitors IoT building telemetry, detects sensor anomalies using isolation forests, and triggers closed-loop operational fixes.
ideas.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent HVAC and Energy Ops for Smart Cities
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced autonomous agent workflows with real-world IoT operations, matching the multi-agent winning pattern from SEAL Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-secured physical logistics validator using an ESP32 microcontroller and custom conductive ink analog signatures to verify product authenticity and detect supply chain tampering on Google Cloud.
ideas.title: Conductive Ink Anti-Counterfeiting Supply Chain Tag
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the unusual physical build pattern and hardware-secured validation that dominated the Hack-4-Viksit Bharat competition.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation platform that combines graph intelligence and Focal LightGBM to provide clear, explainable audit trails for suspicious transactions.
ideas.title: Explainable AML Graph Intelligence for FinTech Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the FinTech category with complex data science and graph intelligence mirroring the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner.
